meta.title: Standard Supermarket Checkout — SommesPro
meta.description: Configure your Standard supermarket checkout in 3D: orientation, belt 900 to 1700 mm, tray module, RAL colour and interior lighting. Steel structure, epoxy paint, 220V motor. Request a quote.
meta.ogDescription: Configure your supermarket checkout in 3D: belt, RAL colour, tray module, lighting. Request a quote online.
meta.ldDescription: Configurable supermarket checkout: degreased sheet steel structure, cold rolling, RAL epoxy paint, conveyor belt 900–1700 mm, single-phase 220V EU motor, mechanically welded frame.

items: NF X35-701 — Prevention of musculoskeletal disorders

NF EN ISO 9241-400 — Ergonomics of human-system interaction
NF EN 12464-1 — Light and lighting of workplaces

tech.title: Technical specifications
items: Single-phase 220V EU standard motor with rubber conveyor belt
Mechanically welded frame with screw levelling
Wide-clearance rear cut-out for quick tray unloading and PRM accessibility

operation.title: Operation
items: Control unit with 2-colour lantern function, forward/reverse belt, optional pedal operation
Stainless steel rear tray for quick cleaning and rapid item evacuation
Full protective skirt on the customer-side

cookie.label: Cookie notice
cookie.text: This site only uses strictly necessary technical cookies. No data is shared with third parties.
